title: fix: set Myceli proxy timeout to 300 seconds
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a manual production-only workflow for the `myceli.ai` zone.
- Reads and reports the current `proxy_read_timeout` before changing it.
- Sets the value to 300 seconds and verifies it through the Cloudflare API.
- Fails without changing anything if the zone is missing, the setting is not editable, or the existing credential lacks permission.

Validation: Prettier, `git diff --check`, and actionlint.

gist.headline: Five Minutes of Patience
gist.blurb: Myceli's Cloudflare proxy now waits up to 300 seconds before calling it quits. Some mushrooms take a little longer to grow.
gist.summary: Added a manual production-only workflow that verifies and sets the myceli.ai Cloudflare `proxy_read_timeout` to 300 seconds, with permission and editability checks before making changes.
gist.impact: Longer Myceli requests can now run for up to five minutes through the proxy, reducing avoidable timeout failures while safely verifying the live setting.

The scene represents longer-running requests safely passing through a patient proxy, with glowing code-fungi and a visible verification checklist.
